purpose: 通过真实审计记录复核递归父拒绝与精确子允许的冲突，显示双方命中、拒绝理由及实际版本。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive scope-decisions.audit --org acme --seq 2 --end-seq 4 --fingerprint "$(cat scope-decisions.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "matched deny policy"
  matched policies: ["p-allow-child", "p-deny-parent"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "matched deny policy"
  matched policies: ["p-allow-child", "p-deny-parent"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 复核关闭父拒绝 Recursive 后的同一子级读取，显示允许结果、单一子策略命中和新的实际版本。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive scope-decisions.audit --org acme --seq 4 --end-seq 4 --fingerprint "$(cat scope-decisions.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 4
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-allow-child"]
  policy version: 2
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-allow-child"]
  policy version: 2
consistent: yes
